methods.ristad: Observed: (m_i+1)(n+1-s)/(n^2+n+2s); unseen: s(s+1)/((d-s)(n^2+n+2s)); add-one if s=d.
methods.good_turing_hybrid: Before normalization, for count t use t/n if t>c_(t+1), otherwise (c_(t+1)+1)(t+1)/(n c_t); unseen symbols use t=0.
methods.dirichlet_concentration_mixture: Uniform prior on tau/d=2^j, j=-24,...,4; exact Dirichlet evidence determines posterior weights; component predictor (m_i+tau/d)/(n+tau).
methods.absolute_discounting: delta=c1/(c1+2c2); observed (m_i-delta)/n; delta*s/n shared among unseen labels. Preserve and report infinite/undefined cases specified in the manuscript; do not silently smooth them.
methods.natural_oracle: q_i=S_(m_i)/c_(m_i), using true target masses within count classes.
methods.lsa_fixed: Unit-power LSA at the explicitly specified depth.
methods.lsa_depth_mixture: Equal prior over integer depths including L=0 where specified; weights updated by sequence evidence.
methods.lsa_power_mixture: One simplex layer raised to fixed integer w; equal prior over w=0,...,80; w=0 is uniform. This is not equivalent to setting unit-power depth L=w.
